name: allProps
signature: function allProps(obj: any, opt: string = 'tvp', depth: number = 6): GenObj | [] | string | boolean

description.brief: Inspects an object to identify its properties, potentially including their values, types, or both.
description.detailed: This function deeply inspects a given object and retrieves as many properties as possible. It can also include property values, types, or parsed details depending on the specified options through the `opt` parameter. The `opt` parameter accepts 'v' for values, 't' for types, 'p' for parsed readable values, and 'f' to avoid filtering uninteresting properties. If none of 't', 'v', or 'p' is specified, it returns an array of property names. If the depth exceeds the specified limit, it stops the recursive inspection.

params.name: obj
params.description: The object to be inspected for its properties. The function will handle both simple and complex objects.

params.name: opt
params.description: A string containing one or more of the following characters: 'v', 't', 'p', 'f'. 'v' returns raw values, 't' returns types, 'p' returns parsed values, and 'f' includes full property details without filtering. If none of these is specified, just an array of property keys will be returned.

params.name: depth
params.description: Defines how deep the recursive search for properties should occur. This prevents infinite recursion in deeply nested structures.

relatedFunctions.name: getProps
relatedFunctions.description: Used for retrieving the own and inherited properties of an object.

relatedFunctions.name: filterProps
relatedFunctions.description: Filters out uninteresting properties from the list of an object's properties.

relatedFunctions.name: uniqueVals
relatedFunctions.description: Ensures uniqueness in an array, which is used when collecting properties.

exampleUsages.description: Inspecting a simple object for its properties and their types.
Retrieving all unfiltered properties and their values from a nested object.
code: const complexObj = { x: { y: { z: 5 } }, arr: [1, 2, 3] };

sourceCode: export function allProps(obj: any, opt: string = 'tvp', depth: number = 6): GenObj | [] | string | boolean { ... }
parameterInterdependencies: The `opt` parameter determines the behavior of what details are returned for the properties of the object, such as just the keys, key-value pairs, or more detailed property information.

errors.description: If the input object is invalid or causes an unexpected error during the property inspection, an exception is caught and a descriptive error message is returned.

return.description: Returns a generalized object structure for properties if key details are requested (via options), a flat array if just keys were requested, a string if the depth limit is exceeded, or boolean if the attempted inspection fails due to input object type checks.

notes: Depth management is crucial to avoid stack overflow errors in deep or recursive objects.
Filtering reduces complex objects to more interesting or relevant properties.
